finding.title: A self-crossing coplanar boundary is falsely certified convex, allowing the actual gear gate to understate penetration.
finding.confidence: Executable contract violation on the unchanged published implementation and real Model type.
finding.classification: Numeric correctness and acceptance-gate failure, not a security vulnerability assessment.

paths.role: convex_patch accepts one boundary loop with same-sign local turns without proving simplicity or convexity.
evaluate assumes convex patch distance and bounds the whole triangle by distances at its vertices.
Penetration::value consumes the claimed upper bound as the actual gate.
certified_penetration requires a closed body, calls surface_depth and exposes exact_penetration.

finding.fixture: An outer closed cuboid contains a closed pentagram prism. Its top fan is connected and coplanar; the pentagram boundary turns all have the same sign but its union is not convex. The actual closure census accepts the complete body. parity_safe=false uses generalized winding, not a parity shortcut.
finding.surface: One triangle joins three adjacent geometric star tips on the prism top. Its vertices and centroid are on the coplanar fan, but part of an edge crosses a gap in that nonconvex patch inside the outer solid.
finding.why_conclusive: The purported upper bound and public gear gate are below the same implementation's own depth at a real point on the measured surface. This does not depend on another renderer, a dense-sampling approximation or a disputed external body-volume convention.

regressions.qualification: Synthetic geometry regression, not a remeasurement or failure count for the2034 source poses.

retained_build_qualification.initial_failure: The published candidate lock refused --locked before any tests ran.
retained_build_qualification.resolution: Copied only the implementer's exact pre-existing uncommitted lock read-only into the isolated review worktree; no packages were installed and no implementer file changed.

required_resolution: Prove a genuinely convex/simple coplanar union or keep separate convex triangles/conservative unresolved bounds. Do not fix by adding only this sample, pruning cases or relaxing thresholds. Repair must precede a trusted whole-denominator result.
